purpose: Pre-registered shadow evaluation of candidate verifier judges (owner decision 2026-10-22). All candidates judge, in parallel, every compare-mode verification in addition to the production judges; its verdict is recorded, never posted, never counted. The criteria below were committed before any shadow data existed.

candidates.why: Cheapest OpenAI judge ($0.1/$0.5 per M tokens); 0 of 19 bad benchmark cases missed against the incumbent's 2 (not statistically distinguishable, p = 0.49).
Newest tier of the production judge's own line (production is gpt-5.6-terra). Owner asked for it explicitly; confirmed served by the OpenAI models API 2026-10-27.
Higher-capability Anthropic tier ($4/$20): does more capability pay?

Meta's Muse API on its own pay-as-you-go key (non-contributor tier, public repositories only). Judges in the daily report job from the saved verifier inputs, because consumer workflows hold no Muse credential. Baseline: the production OpenAI judge.
Cursor CLI in read-only ask mode on the Workflows CURSOR_API_KEY. Judges in the daily report job from the saved verifier inputs. Baseline: the production OpenAI judge.

window.note: The window closes after min_days AND min_runs paired runs; at max_days it closes as INSUFFICIENT, never as a pass. About 13 verified PRs are expected a week fleet-wide.

criteria.note: candidate miss = candidate PASS where the incumbent slot did not PASS. Extra flag = candidate not PASS where the incumbent slot PASSed. Class agreement = PASS versus not-PASS agreement. Cost compares registry list prices on observed tokens when both are reported, otherwise it is informational.

on_rollback: A candidate miss on a PR that later reverts or draws a verifier follow-up is listed in the report as a defect the incumbent caught and the candidate missed; one such case ends the evaluation as DOES NOT MEET.
owner_time: One read of the day-7 report (about 2 minutes) before any promotion; nothing blocks while the shadow runs.
note_on_many_candidates: Every candidate is evaluated against the same criteria, each against the production slot of its own provider (openai against gpt-5.6-terra, anthropic against claude-sonnet-5-5). Judging several candidates raises the chance that one meets the criteria by luck, so promotion picks among those that MEET by cost and does not treat a single MEETS as proof of superiority.
note_on_candidate_choice: Only the newest model of each line is shadowed: gpt-6.1-sol rather than gpt-6-sol or gpt-5.6, claude-opus-5-5 rather than opus-5, and no Anthropic model older than the production claude-sonnet-5-5. gpt-6-luna stays because no 6.1 luna exists. External candidates (runner: external) are judged by tools/verifier_shadow_external.py in the daily report job.
note_on_pipelines: Entries recorded before the in-workflow candidates ran the production per-slot path (strict coverage, chunked review: compare-slot/v2) are ignored; the first version used evaluate_pr, whose lenient coverage rule made candidates answer an easier question than the production judge did.
